parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are substantial and operative: a top-court ruling makes single-sex services (changing rooms, hostels, medical services) follow biological sex nationally; a statutory code in force since 5 Aug 2026 implements this; police in at least one force strip-search trans women by sex at birth; a regional court-documented policy of housing trans prisoners by birth sex is only just struck down and government defends it; a documented hospital-ward exclusion death case; and a documented national shift in rhetoric. Offsetting: the 2004 GRC regime still issues certificates, discrimination protection on gender reassignment continues, and recourse exists (challenges pending). Hate-crime protection on gender identity covers only some regions. Traveller exposure is at the Elevated-to-High boundary; I place it in the Elevated band given no documented visitor-specific targeting or criminalisation, but universal-exposure facility and ward rules are heavy.
